scope: Four-frame, in-place landing recovery after Todd's jump animation.
tool: PixelLab Animate with Text v3 via animate_image

generation.inputProvenance: Approved Todd jump sheet, displayed frame 8 of 9 (zero-based frame index 7).
generation.endingGuideProvenance: Approved Todd idle sheet, frame 1 (zero-based frame index 0).
generation.prompt: Todd absorbs the jump landing in place: bend both knees and lower his hips briefly with both sneakers planted, then rise smoothly back to his relaxed upright fighting guard matching the supplied final-frame guide. Keep the same screen-left three-quarter facing, keep his feet on the same ground baseline and his body centered without horizontal travel. Show four distinct recovery poses with a clear impact absorption and controlled rise. Preserve the exact character design and outfit from the input.

alignment.method: Preserve generated pixels and translate each frame vertically so its lowest opaque pixel aligns to Todd's approved y=251 ground baseline. Original generated frames are retained unchanged.
alignment.reviewNote: Frame 2 has a brief rebound with one boot lifted; accepted as part of the approved recovery.
